subject: Meeting with Jaka Bizilj at the Paris Peace Forum | Humanitarian action and survivor-centred engagement
originalBody:
Dear Dr. Mukwege,

I am writing to ask whether you might be available for a brief meeting with Jaka Bizilj, founder of The World Forum and Cinema for Peace, during the Paris Peace Forum on 10–11 November 2026.

draftBody:
Dear Najib,

Thank you for reaching out to the Panzi Foundation and for your kind words about Dr. Mukwege's work and the mission of Panzi Hospital. We are grateful for the meaningful work Cinema for Peace and The World Forum have done to elevate humanitarian causes on the global stage.

We have taken note of your request for a brief meeting between Dr. Mukwege and Jaka Bizilj during the Paris Peace Forum on 10–11 November 2026, and we will forward your message to Dr. Mukwege's team for their review.

To help us assess this request properly, we would kindly ask that you share a few additional details: a formal invitation letter if available, the preferred date and time within the forum schedule, the proposed format and location of the meeting, and any logistical arrangements that would be in place. This will allow Dr. Mukwege's team to review the request in full.

Please note that we are unable to confirm Dr. Mukwege's availability at this stage, but we will ensure your message reaches the appropriate contacts as promptly as possible.

With gratitude,
The Panzi Foundation Team
